description: This is a Java class file defining the TransactionService class, which handles fund transfers and utility payments within a banking microservice, including validation, account balance management, and transaction recording.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: Handles transaction operations such as fund transfers and utility payments with balance validation, recording transactions, and interacting with repositories.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Performs a funds transfer between two bank accounts after validating available balance.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Processes a utility payment by deducting funds from an account and recording the transaction.

methods.name: validateBalance
methods.description: Checks if the account has sufficient funds for a transaction.

methods.name: internalFundTransfer
methods.description: Handles the internal logic of transferring funds between two accounts, updating balances, and saving transaction records.
